title: 'Abasa 80:25-33 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 'Abasa 80:25-33 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 18. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا (٢٥) ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا (٢٦) فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا (٢٧) وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا (٢٨) وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا (٢٩) وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا (٣٠) وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا (٣١) مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ (٣٢) فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ (٣٣)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: How We poured down water in torrents, Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
And caused to grow within it grain And grapes and herbage
And olive and palm trees And gardens of dense shrubbery
And fruit and grass - [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
But when there comes the Deafening Blast

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: sab-baa: press the baa; stop with a long aa

questions.q: Chunk and link 'Abasa 80:25-33 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 80:25-33 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 80:25-33 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List the plants named in 80:27 to 31.
questions.a: Grain, grapes, herbage (qadb), olives, date palms, dense gardens, fruit, grass (abb).

questions.q: Recite 80:1 to 33 and count the idgham with ghunnah in 80:25 to 33.
questions.a: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا, وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا, وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا (three).

questions.q: 80:32 says these plants are provision for ...
questions.a: A) you and your livestock. 'As provision for you and your grazing livestock' (80:32).

questions.q: Think again: Rain, split earth, grain, grapes, olives, dates, gardens, fruit: 80:25 to 32 lists them. Which one did you eat this week?
questions.a: Most of us ate several: each is 'provision for you and your livestock' (80:32), a reason for gratitude.
